name: Elisabeth
bio: Elisabeth, a descendant of Aaron, and her husband, the priest Zacharias, were righteous before God but childless and advanced in years. The angel Gabriel announced to Zacharias in the temple that she would bear a son, to be named John, who would go before the Lord in the spirit of Elijah; Elisabeth conceived and, in her sixth month, was visited by her relative Mary, newly pregnant with Jesus. When Mary greeted her, the baby leaped in Elisabeth's womb, and filled with the Holy Spirit she blessed Mary as the mother of her Lord and pronounced her blessed for believing the angel's word. Elisabeth gave birth to a son and, against her neighbors' expectation that he be named for his father, insisted he be called John, as the angel had said (Luke 1:5-25, 36-45, 57-66).
